# Feature request

## Problem

What is difficult or missing today? Who is affected?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change and any compatibility or workflow implications.

## Alternatives and evidence

What workarounds exist? Include links to relevant docs, hardware specifications, or comparable emulator behavior when applicable.

## Scope

- [ ] User-facing behavior
- [ ] Emulator accuracy/compatibility
- [ ] Developer tooling or documentation
- [ ] Release/packaging
